title: How to Build an NFT dApp With DropChain
summary: Discover how DropChain is revolutionizing NFT dApp development, offering both no-code and coding solutions to democratize blockchain technology for all, regardless of experience.
author: Nathaniel Thoreson
body:
Building web3 apps is hard. However, the race to simplify the creation of decentralized applications (dApps) has begun. DropChain is on a mission to enable anyone to easily build dApps and NFTs, regardless of their level of experience. DropChain offers both code and no-code solutions for building NFT dApps. This approach is not just a nod to inclusivity but a strategic move to democratize access to blockchain technology. Let's delve into how DropChain is changing the game for NFT dApp development.


DropChain: Bridging the Gap in NFT dApp Development

At its core, DropChain is a web3 API platform that simplifies the process of creating NFT dApps. It's a tool that caters to both the tech-savvy and the tech-averse, offering a unique blend of accessibility and sophistication. This dual approach is a game-changer in an industry often criticized for its steep learning curve and technical barriers.


The No-Code Revolution

In the no-code corner, DropChain integrates seamlessly with platforms like Bubble, Wix, and FlutterFlow. This integration allows users to utilize the DropChain plugin to give your no-code app all the web3 functionality you could ask for. The development process is as simple as dragging and dropping elements. It's an approach that opens the doors to a broader audience, allowing those without coding expertise to participate in the NFT space actively.


Coding for the Connoisseurs

For those who prefer a more hands-on approach, DropChain offers an API and SDK for developers to flex their coding muscles. This option caters to those who seek a more tailored and intricate development process, allowing for a higher degree of customization and complexity in their NFT dApps.

Traditionally, coding web3 apps required you to learn how to build smart contracts - no easy task even for seasoned developers. The DropChain API allows you to call 30+ premade blockchain smart contracts. With DropChain, you can get all the benefits of web3 with none of the specialized knowledge.
